about: Front JA0: Japanese strings that may equal their English source or hold no Japanese character, each with a reason (plan front-i18n-ja.md §5.4). Keys are the lint's string ids: `catalog:<key>`, `map:<id>.<path>`, `original:<normalised original>`.

entries.catalog:app.name: product name (OpenVireo)
entries.catalog:instructorMode.optionsClosedOk: OK, as Windows Japanese writes it
entries.map:helpMenu.ok: OK, as Windows Japanese writes it
entries.original:OK: OK, as Windows Japanese writes it
entries.original:YYYY/MM/DD: date format pattern, typed with these letters
entries.original:(km/sec): a unit (km/s), as VIREO writes it
entries.original:PDot (S/S):: pulsar parameter symbol (period derivative, s/s), a formula symbol
entries.original:PEpoch (MJD):: pulsar parameter symbol (period epoch, MJD), a formula symbol
entries.catalog:siteClock.utValue: a time value and the UT symbol, as Japanese writes it («12:00:00 UT»)
entries.catalog:siteClock.hoursValue: a value and the hour symbol h (hours of right ascension or time), a unit symbol
entries.catalog:runningClock.coordinateValue: coordinate values with the unit symbols h and °, no words
entries.catalog:horizon.degrees: a value and the degree sign, no words
entries.catalog:motion.rateOption: a rate value and the multiplication sign (2×), no words
entries.catalog:htl.row: three values joined with · (number, identifier, remarks), no words
entries.catalog:cameraPrepare.ir: filter set name (IR), as VIREO's camera writes it
entries.catalog:cameraPrepare.catalogEntry: a filter letter and a catalogue band name (NOMAD R), no words
entries.catalog:multispec.ok: OK, as Windows Japanese writes it
entries.catalog:scopeAccess.ok: OK, as Windows Japanese writes it
entries.catalog:optionsFile.ok: OK, as Windows Japanese writes it
entries.catalog:instrumentParameters.errorOk: OK, as Windows Japanese writes it
entries.map:camera.accessReason.ready: empty: no reason is shown when the camera is ready
entries.map:camera.sourceWithHash: a source label and a SHA-256 prefix joined with ·, no words
entries.map:camera.rowCounts: three counts joined with /, no words
entries.map:fieldInfo.ok: OK, as Windows Japanese writes it
entries.map:observatory.common.ok: OK, as Windows Japanese writes it
entries.map:observatory.skyCoords.ok: OK, as Windows Japanese writes it
